title: Russian Beet Salad with Herring
description: This recipe for Russian-style beet salad with herring also includes onions, potatoes, and carrots. It's unique, tasty, and a Russian holiday must-have.
ingredients: 2 beets, washed with tops and bottoms removed
1 (12 ounce) jar herring fillets, packed in oil
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add potatoes, carrots, and beets; cook until cooked but still firm, 15 to 20 minutes for potatoes, 25 to 30 minutes for carrots, and 40 minutes for beets. Transfer vegetables to a cutting board as they're each done; cool to the touch.
Remove and discard skins from potatoes and beets. Grate potatoes, carrots, and beets separately; placing each in a separate bowl.

Arrange 1/2 each onion then herring in layers in a large bowl. Arrange 1/2 each potatoes, carrots, and beets in layers on top of onion and herring. Spread 3 tablespoons mayonnaise over salad; season with salt and black pepper. Repeat layers with remaining 1/2 each onion, herring, potatoes, carrots, beets, and mayonnaise.
Cover with plastic wrap; chill in the refrigerator at least 1 hour. Serve cold.
